commands.sql: INSERT INTO t (c,p,n) VALUES (NULL,'new',2) RETURNING c,p,n
UPDATE t AS q SET p=NULL WHERE n=1 RETURNING q.p,old.c,new.c,q.n
UPDATE t SET c='changed' WHERE n=1 RETURNING WITH (OLD AS prior, NEW AS next) prior.c,next.p,n
DELETE FROM t WHERE n=1 RETURNING old.c,new.p,old.n
MERGE INTO t USING (VALUES (1,'updated')) s(n,v) ON t.n=s.n WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p=s.v RETURNING old.c,new.p,t.p
INSERT INTO t (c,p,n) VALUES ('conflict',NULL,1) ON CONFLICT(n) DO UPDATE SET c=excluded.c RETURNING c,p
UPDATE t AS q SET p='x' RETURNING q.*
UPDATE t SET p='x' RETURNING old.*

queries.sql: WITH changed AS (UPDATE t SET p=NULL RETURNING old.c AS c,new.p AS p) SELECT p,c FROM changed
WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM t RETURNING new.c AS c,old.p AS p) SELECT c,p FROM removed
